Author: KeydenK
Name: Beeline
Punchline: Point at anything on your map and press one button: Beeline takes you there the quickest way.
Description: Point at anything on your map and press one button (controller, mouse or keyboard): Beeline takes you there the quickest way, picking between walking, the aethernet or a teleport, then mounting, flying and walking the rest for you. Made for questing: quest markers are used at their exact position, so you end up right next to the quest NPC or object, targeted and ready to talk to, and at a safe distance from quest enemies. Works on aetherytes, aethernet shards, quest and leve markers, quest areas and any spot, in any zone. Moving your character stops the trip at once. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh. Command: /beeline
Changelog: New settings window with tabs (Controls, Travel, Questing, Advanced) and explanations on hover; each input now has its own Off. Pick the mount Beeline summons: Mount Roulette or any mount you've unlocked. Mounting is decided by time, not distance: Beeline summons your mount whenever riding or flying gets you there sooner than staying on foot, and you keep moving while it's summoned. Smoother flying: you start moving the moment you arrive instead of standing still while the flying path is computed, and the path picks up from where you are, without turning back. A trip can no longer get stuck: if you can't move for a while, Beeline mounts you again, recomputes the route, goes on the ground, or stops the trip. On foot: Sprint when it's ready (you then keep Jog), otherwise Peloton kept up for jobs that have it. Route estimates learn each speed separately (running, Peloton, Sprint, Jog, riding, flying), how long getting on your mount takes (your ping included) and how much longer real paths are than a straight line. Beeline never summons a mount while another one is being summoned, and tells you when another plugin's auto-mount or auto-dismount feature knocks you off at take-off.
